customer.business: MyLiquid app (an AI agent with a Tamagotchi-style pet that invests and pays within your limits)
customer.target: US self-directed investors who invest monthly in a broker app, already ask ChatGPT or Claude about money, and have $5,000 to $250,000 invested
customer.where: United States, phones (installable web app, Android)
customer._sources: Segments A and B from docs/discovery/1-problem-and-audience.md; objections from its assumptions A1-A5, founder/board.md and founder/competitors.md (free agents at Robinhood and Public). Shares and income ranges are estimates, not data; no interviews have been done yet.

segments.name: Busy delegator (uses a robo-adviser or nothing)

behaviours.name: Broker-app power user
behaviours.how: Checks Robinhood or Public daily and trades a few times a month.

behaviours.name: Monthly autopilot investor
behaviours.how: Puts the same amount into index funds every month and rarely looks.

behaviours.name: Asks AI before acting
behaviours.how: Pastes portfolio questions into ChatGPT or Claude, then trades by hand.

behaviours.name: Sceptic of AI with money
behaviours.how: Uses AI at work but will not let it touch money.

behaviours.name: Fee minimiser
behaviours.how: Picks the cheapest option and dislikes subscriptions.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Will not try a finance app without reviews and a known name behind it.

behaviours.name: Likes games and streaks
behaviours.how: Tries new apps and keeps streaks going in a few of them.

objections: I don't trust an AI with my money
My broker already has free AI agents
A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money
Who is liable if the agent loses money?
I'm not paying a subscription to invest
Demo money isn't worth my time
Is my data safe with a new app?
habits: you check your portfolio on the commute
you asked ChatGPT about your retirement account last month
you already pay for two or three subscriptions
you follow a few finance creators

pitch:
MyLiquid: an app where an AI agent, shown as a Tamagotchi-style pet, invests, rebalances and pays for you within limits you set. Anything bigger waits for your tap, one switch stops it, and every decision is kept in a record you can download.
Today it is free and runs on demo money, with real end-of-day prices for index funds and bitcoin. It installs on your phone from the browser.
Real-money accounts are planned later through a licensed broker partner, with a paid monthly plan, MyLiquid Plus, at a price not set yet.
The question on the page: join the waitlist for MyLiquid Plus, the paid real-money plan?
Price questions: answer in US dollars per month.
